operations.description: The Company Basic Search API searches for a company based on the input and will returns results containing basic details about matching companies. By default the API returns the top 10 available results unless the limit is specified. The maximum limit is restricted to 30.
operations.summary: Basic Search Company by Ticker or Website or Name or PermID
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] basic company search [PATH] company basicsearch [PARAMS] fields format limit q [SCHEMA] address basic company results search vo

operations.description: The Competitors API provides basic information about top 3 competitors of a company specified in the Company Id
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] company competitor id [PARAMS] company format id [SCHEMA] basic company competitor vo

operations.description: The Competitors API provides basic information about top 3 competitors of a company specified in the website
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] company competitor url [PARAMS] format website [SCHEMA] basic company competitor vo

operations.description: The Competitors API provides basic information about all competitors of a given company Id
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] company competitorpremium id [PARAMS] company format id pagination [SCHEMA] basic competitor competitors vo

operations.description: The Competitors API provides basic information about all competitors of a given company Id
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] company competitorpremium url [PARAMS] format id pagination website [SCHEMA] basic competitor competitors vo

operations.description: The Company Fuzzy Search API searches for a company based on the input and will return results containing basic details about matching companies. By default the API returns at most top 10 available results unless the limit is specified. The maximum limit is restricted to 30.
operations.summary: Fuzzy Search Company by Name or Address or Phone
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] fuzzy company search [PATH] company fuzzysearch [PARAMS] fields format limit q [SCHEMA] fuzzy results

operations.description: The Company Data API provides complete information about a company for the specified Company Id
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] company id [PARAMS] company format id [SCHEMA] acquisition address ceo company funding investor sector stock vo

operations.description: The Company Search API searches for a company based on the input and will returns results containing basic details about matching companies. By default the API returns the top 10 available results unless the limit is specified. The maximum limit is restricted to 30.
operations.summary: Search Company by Ticker or Website or Name or PermID
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] search company [PATH] company search [PARAMS] fields format limit q [SCHEMA] basic company feeds results vo

operations.description: The Company Data API provides complete information about a company for the specified URL
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] company url [PARAMS] format website [SCHEMA] acquisition address ceo company funding investor sector stock vo

operations.description: The Company Premium Data API provides complete information about a company for the specified Company Id
operations.summary: Get Complete Company Info by Id
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] companypremium id [PARAMS] company format id [SCHEMA] acquisition address ceo company funding investor sector stock vo

operations.description: The Company Data API provides complete information about a company for the specified URL
operations.summary: Get Basic Company Info by Url
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] companypremium url [PARAMS] format website [SCHEMA] acquisition address ceo company funding investor sector stock vo

operations.description: The Feeds API provides a list of feeds and individual feed information for the given Company Ids and Category. By default the API returns the latest 10 feeds available unless the limit is specified. The maximum result is restricted to 100 feeds per API request.
operations.summary: Get Feeds for given Company Ids
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] feed [PARAMS] category company format id limit pagination [SCHEMA] basic company feeds results vo

operations.description: The Feeds API provides a list of feeds and individual feed information for the given Company Websites and Category. By default the API returns the latest 10 feeds available unless the limit is specified. The maximum result is restricted to 100 feeds per API request.
operations.summary: Get Feeds for given Company Websites
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] feed url [PARAMS] category domain format id limit pagination [SCHEMA] basic company feeds results vo
